//: Only inside a tag. `else`, `if` and `each` are ordinary English words, and a selector reaching the whole document highlights them in prose.

each.//: The whole attribute, quotes and all. Matching the name alone leaves the value to the HTML grammar, which has already passed the point where an attribute may start: it scopes the `=` as an illegal character and reads the value's words as more attribute names.

patterns.//: `item of list` or `item, index of list`. Anchored, so only the head of the value is a declaration and everything after `of` is an expression.

expression.//: A bare expression. `else-if` before `if`, or the alternation matches the tail of the longer name.

flag.//: The two that take no value. `fragment` names a region of a page; `else` closes a chain.
flag.name: keyword.control.directive.transclude
